P2_independent_benchmark.criterion: max |dC|,|dP| < 1e-6 m; attitude angle and |dpsi| < 1e-6 rad vs verifier GL4 at identical params

P4_energy_production_run.label: production run (as given)
P4_energy_production_run.criterion: |E + W_diss - E0| < 1e-7 E_osc; forward dE <= 1e-12 E_osc; L_z balance < 1e-8 L_ref

P4_energy_conservative.label: conservative variant
P4_energy_conservative.criterion: |E - E0| < 1e-8 E_osc (conservative run); L_z balance < 1e-8 L_ref

P2_conservative_variant.criterion: max |dC|,|dP| < 1e-6 m; attitude angle and |dpsi| < 1e-6 rad vs verifier GL4 at identical params

P7_forces.criterion: tension >= 0 (column and recomputation M a_C + M g z + c_v v_C along u); column vs recomputed < 1e-6 Mg

P8_initial_conditions_time.criterion: t[n] = n/96 (1e-12 s); |q| = 1 (1e-12); IC vs params < 1e-9; |P-A| = L, C = P - R p_b, psi column = model convention (1e-9); best-fit time scale |s-1| < 1e-6

B4_swing_1e-5rad_lowest_mode.note: string mode: released in the lowest linear mode shape (wire angle, disc tilt) from the B4 eigenproblem
